description_en: You can call UntagResources to detach tags from specified ECI resources
description_zh: 调用UntagResources为指定的ECI资源解绑标签
kebab_example: aliyun eci untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id eci-2zelg8vwnlzdhf8hv0000 --resource-type ContainerGroup --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the resource resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: A list of tag keys to detach. You can enter up to 20 tag keys
parameters.help_zh: 要解绑的标签键列表。最多可输入20个标签键
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

ContainerGroup: ECI instance

ImageCache: image cache

DataCache: data cache

VirtualNode: virtual node
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。取值范围：

ContainerGroup：ECI实例
ImageCache：镜像缓存
DataCache：数据缓存
VirtualNode：虚拟节点
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to detach all tags from the resource. This parameter is valid only when `TagKey` is not set in the request. Valid values:

true

false

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否解绑资源上全部的标签。当请求中未设置 `TagKey`时，该参数才有效。取值范围：

true
false

默认值：false
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
